title: Deterministic Controller Kernel
outcome: A fake Pipeline Command is accepted or rejected deterministically, survives process restart, produces deduplicated Events, rebuildable projections, and Outbox Effects, and cannot be advanced by a stale worker generation.

slices.title: Domain kernel
slices.demonstration: Pure evaluator accepts ConfirmRequirement and rejects invalid transitions without I/O.

slices.title: Durable transaction
slices.demonstration: Acknowledged fake commands survive restart without loss or duplication.

slices.title: Projection and read
slices.demonstration: Projection rebuilds from the Event Log; read returns fixture fields only.

slices.title: Outbox and replay
slices.demonstration: Outbox replay does not append a second business Event.

slices.title: Lease and fencing
slices.demonstration: A stale lease generation cannot change Pipeline state.

slices.title: Crash demonstration
slices.demonstration: Fault-injected pause/cancel/cleanup and Phase Closeout bind to the integrated Candidate.

invariants: Controller domain code has no LangGraph, SQL, filesystem, or Adapter import.
SQLite remains the single-writer v1 store.

testing: Deterministic unit and property tests for the aggregate; persistence tests cover restart, conflict, and fencing.
migration: Kernel schema is introduced with an explicit migration seam; no production Workspace migration.
security: No secret interpolation; no Agent or Git authority in this Phase.
documentation: PHASE.md, slice contracts, and Phase Closeout stay synchronized.
demonstration: One fake command path survives restart and rejects a stale worker on the integrated Candidate.

exit_criteria.observable_result: Domain evaluator is pure and deterministic; invalid commands leave state unchanged.
One atomic SQLite transaction covers Inbox, Events, and revision; restart neither loses nor duplicates an acknowledged command.
Projection rebuilds from the Event Log; read returns only authorized fixture fields.
Outbox replay is idempotent; a second delivery does not append a second business Event.
Results from an expired lease generation cannot change Pipeline state.
Crash, pause, and cancel demonstration and Phase Closeout are recorded on the integrated Candidate.

exclusions: Project RBAC, Feishu, GitHub, Agent execution, Managed Worktree
Promoting keep-marked transport or runtime_broker as sealed runtime

risks.description: Rewriting 00-04 persistence silently promotes spike code.
risks.mitigation: 01-02 must rewrite behind ControllerPort and flip dispositions explicitly.
risks.trigger: Production kernel imports spike modules as the public Interface.

risks.description: Acknowledged commands are lost or duplicated across restart.
risks.mitigation: Fault-inject every durable boundary in 01-02 and 01-06.
risks.trigger: A second Event or missing receipt after restart.

risks.mitigation: Generation checks before every mutation in 01-05.
risks.trigger: An expired lease result is accepted.

stop_conditions: SQLite loses or duplicates an acknowledged command
LangGraph is required inside the Controller
A new dependency family becomes necessary
The fake aggregate is rejected in favor of the full Stage machine
